Your Oelo Installation Choices

Every home is different, so the track, mount, and color style are chosen together during your design visit.

🔲

Acrylic Cover

A flush look with the LEDs hidden behind a lens. Oelo describes the acrylic as impact- and fade-resistant.

🔩

Metal Cover

Fabricated in the US with minimal mounting components and bend channels for corners and angles.

📐

Face, Accent, or Under Mount

Face mount points the lights outward and lets individual LEDs be controlled. Accent mount grazes the wall, and under mount washes the wall below the eave.

🎨

White or Multi-Color

Choose single-color white or multi-color lighting with patterns and movement for holidays and events.

How We Measure and Quote Your Roofline

Your quote is built from your actual roofline, not a one-size price.

1

Measure the Roofline

Alex measures the roofline, fascia, and soffit where you want lighting and notes peaks, corners, and levels.

2

Plan the Layout

Runs, corners, power, and controller location are mapped out so the track follows your home cleanly.

3

Written Quote

Your written quote covers how penetrations are sealed, who handles any electrical work, app setup and walkthrough, and the warranty and workmanship terms.

What Affects Your Quote

  • The length of roofline you want lit
  • The layout: runs, corners, peaks, and multiple levels
  • Access to power for the controller

Read more: permanent lighting cost guide for South Jersey and Oelo DIY vs. professional installation.

WRITTEN WARRANTY

Oelo's warranty term depends on who installs the system. Your written quote states which term applies to your installation.

  • For installs on or after January 1, 2024: 7 years when installed by an Authorized, Preferred, or Platinum Oelo Dealer; 5 years for contractor and DIY installs.
  • The first year includes directly required labor (not soffit, metalwork, or flashing). After that, coverage is for components only.
  • The warranty is held by the homeowner and can be transferred once within 60 days of a home sale. Claims must be made within 30 days.

Permanent Lighting Questions

What do Oelo lights look like during the day?

Oelo describes its lights as practically invisible by day. The track blends in with your home's fascia, and the acrylic cover gives a flush look with the LEDs hidden behind a lens.

How do I control permanent roofline lights?

With the Oelo Evolution app on iPhone or Android. You can pick from more than 16 million hues, use pre-set patterns, save your own, schedule daily, weekly or yearly patterns up to 12 months ahead, and control zones and multiple buildings over WiFi, cellular or Ethernet. Oelo lists the system as Alexa and Google Home ready.

What affects the price of permanent roofline lighting?

The main quote factors are the length of roofline you want lit, the layout (runs, corners and peaks), and access to power for the controller. Alex measures on site and gives you a written quote rather than a one-size price.

What warranty comes with Oelo lights?

For installs on or after January 1, 2024, Oelo offers 7 years when installed by an Authorized, Preferred or Platinum Dealer and 5 years for contractor and DIY installs. The first year includes directly required labor (not soffit, metalwork or flashing); after that, components only. It's transferable once within 60 days of a home sale, and claims must be made within 30 days. Your written quote states which term applies.
